products.description: The MP-1 is a single instrument that covers most transient techniques used to characterise thermal transport. The transient plane source (TPS) sensor, a nickel double spiral between insulating layers, measures solids, pastes and powders and returns conductivity, diffusivity, volumetric specific heat and effusivity in one test, while also quantifying the contact resistance between sensor and sample. Optional testing modules cover bulk, anisotropic, slab, thin-film, one-dimensional, contact-resistance and specific-heat measurements. products.name: THW-L1 Transient Hot Wire Liquid Thermal Conductivity Meter
products.summary: The THW-L1 is a laboratory transient hot wire instrument for the thermal conductivity, diffusivity and specific heat of liquids and phase-change materials. A one-second test limits convection, the cell can be pressurised to 35 bar, and an integrated temperature platform covers −160 to 300 °C depending on model.
products.description: The THW-L1 measures liquids by sending a pulse of current through a thin hot wire immersed in the sample and recording the temperature rise at 100 points per second. Because the measurement lasts one second, convection has little time to disturb the result, so low-viscosity fluids and highly viscous ones, from 0.001 to 10 million cP, can be tested on the same instrument. The method follows ASTM D7896-19 and returns thermal conductivity, thermal diffusivity and calculated specific heat from a single 20 mL sample. The sample cell can be back-filled with pressure to test liquids beyond their boiling points. The family has three variants: the THW-L1 for 10 to 200 °C and up to 20 bar without external cooling, the THW-L1S for −40 to 200 °C, and the THW-L1E reaching −160 to 300 °C with pressure up to 35 bar; the latter two need an external cooling apparatus. The wire clamp allows quick replacement, and Windows software controls isothermal temperature steps, checks data quality and exports reports to Excel. Accessories include paste, powder and observation cells and a vertical cell mount. Typical users test coolants, heat-transfer fluids, nanofluids and phase-change materials.

products.name: HFM-100 Heat Flow Meter
products.summary: The HFM-100 is a steady-state heat flow meter for the thermal resistance and thermal conductivity of insulation products, construction materials, packaging and assemblies up to 300 × 300 × 100 mm. Peltier plates, flux sensors and optical thickness encoders deliver 1 to 2 % accuracy in a 30 to 40 minute test.
products.description: A heat flow meter places a flat specimen between two temperature-controlled plates and measures the heat flux crossing it once steady state is reached. In the HFM-100 a heat flux sensor with surface thermocouples is built into each plate, and thermoelectric Peltier elements heat and cool the plates with a resolution below 0.01 °C. Four optical encoders, one at each corner of the upper plate, measure specimen thickness to 0.05 mm, and stepper motors close the plates automatically on rigid samples or stop at a user-defined thickness for compressible materials such as batting. Thermal resistance and thermal conductivity are reported from the full thickness, which is why the method suits heterogeneous insulation products and assemblies. The instrument is factory calibrated and shipped with a NIST standard reference material, fibrous glass board SRM 1450e. It can be operated from the front panel or through Windows software that allows unlimited temperature steps, and a quality-control mode shortens test time. A high thermal conductivity kit extends the range to 2.5 W/m·K and a specific heat module is optional. It is intended for building-product manufacturers, insulation producers, certification laboratories and universities.

products.summary: The HFM-100 HT is the extended-temperature version of the HFM-100 heat flow meter, with plates controlled from −30 to 110 °C. It tests insulation and construction materials up to 300 × 300 × 100 mm for thermal resistance and conductivity to ASTM C518, ISO 8301 and EN 12667.
products.description: The HFM-100 HT keeps the measurement principle and sample envelope of the HFM-100 but widens the plate temperature range to −30 to 110 °C, so insulation can be characterised closer to the temperatures it sees in service. A specimen up to 300 × 300 mm and 100 mm thick is clamped between two Peltier-controlled plates, each carrying a heat flux sensor with surface thermocouples. Once the heat flux is steady, thermal resistance and conductivity are calculated for the full thickness, which suits heterogeneous insulation and assemblies. Four optical encoders measure thickness to 0.05 mm and the plates can close automatically on rigid samples or stop at a set thickness for compressible ones. Accuracy is 1 to 2 % with repeatability of 0.5 to 1 %, verified against NIST reference boards, and a test takes 30 to 40 minutes. A chilled circulator is required for the full temperature range. Software provides unlimited automated temperature steps, and optional kits add specific heat measurement and conductivity up to 2.5 W/m·K. The HT model is chosen by insulation producers, certification bodies and research groups that need conductivity as a function of temperature, including above ambient conditions.

products.name: HFM-25 Portable Heat Flow Meter
products.summary: The HFM-25 is a compact heat flow meter for thermal resistance and conductivity of small insulation and construction material samples, as small as 50 × 50 × 2 mm. products.description: The HFM-25 was designed for steady-state testing of small insulation samples where a full-size heat flow meter would be excessive. A specimen is placed between two heating and cooling plates, each with an integrated heat flux sensor, and the contact pressure is set manually with standard weights. A digital gauge reports thickness, and shims allow compressible samples to be tested at a controlled thickness. The instrument detects ambient temperature automatically and offers temperature differences of 5, 10, 15 or 20 °C between the plates; heat flux is monitored until it stabilises, then thermal resistance is measured and thermal conductivity calculated. Samples as small as 50 × 50 × 2 mm up to 25.4 mm thick can be tested, and the open clamping arrangement accepts larger boards up to 300 × 300 mm so several locations can be checked for homogeneity. Typical results include aerogel blanket within 3 % of the manufacturer's value and a NIST SRM 1450d board within 1 % of its certificate. The HFM-25 follows ASTM C518, ISO 8301, JIS A1412 and EN 12667 and suits product development, incoming inspection and teaching laboratories.

products.name: GHFM-01 Guarded Heat Flow Meter
products.summary: The GHFM-01 is a guarded heat flow meter that follows ASTM E1530 to measure the thermal resistance and conductivity of metals, polymers, composites and pastes from −20 to 310 °C. Motor-controlled clamping sets thickness, force or pressure automatically, with conductivity up to 100 W/m·K.
products.description: The GHFM-01 measures thermal resistance through the full thickness of a sample, which is the most dependable way to obtain true conductivity of heterogeneous materials such as composites, filled polymers and layered assemblies. A 50 mm disc is held between a heated upper plate and a heat-sink lower plate, with a guard oven reducing lateral heat loss. The lower heat flux stack is calibrated as a transducer and can be exchanged without tools. Six thermocouples with 0.01 °C resolution confirm steady state. Instead of the pneumatic movement of conventional guarded stacks, a stepper motor with a force sensor and optical encoder controls clamping, so thickness, force or pressure up to 379 kPa can be programmed and thickness is read to 0.0254 mm. This is useful for compressible materials such as rubber and gaskets, and a layering approach allows thin films to be measured. Software schedules unlimited temperature steps from −20 to 310 °C, and a chilled circulator is included. Conductivity range is 0.1 to 100 W/m·K with 3 % accuracy and 1 to 2 % repeatability. Test cells for pastes, polymer melts and powders extend the application range.

products.description: The TPS-3 brings the transient plane source method to laboratories with limited budgets. The measurement uses a 20 mm nickel double-spiral sensor sandwiched between two pieces of the same sample; a current passes through the sensor, heating it, and the heat diffuses into the specimen at a rate set by the material's thermal transport properties while the temperature rise is recorded over time. From that curve the software calculates thermal conductivity, thermal diffusivity and volumetric specific heat, and because the method is absolute no calibration standards or contact agents are required. The package consists of the standard TPS sensor and software working with a Keithley 2400/2401 source meter, which can be supplied with the instrument or provided by the user. Conductivity range is 0.03 to 70 W/m·K, test times are 10 to 160 seconds, the smallest sample is 40 mm in diameter by 5 mm thick, and operation covers 10 to 80 °C. Published checks include NIST EPS 1453 at 3.6 % deviation from its reference value, Pyrex glass at 1.7 % and stainless steel 316 at 13.81 W/m·K. It suits teaching, polymer and metals screening and general materials laboratories.

products.name: TLS-100 Soil and Rock Thermal Conductivity Meter
products.summary: The TLS-100 is a portable transient line source meter for the thermal conductivity and thermal resistivity of soil, rock, concrete and polymers. Needle probes of 50, 100 or 150 mm are auto-recognised, a test takes three minutes, and the method follows ASTM D5334-22a and IEEE 442-2017.
products.description: The TLS-100 measures thermal conductivity and thermal resistivity with a needle probe pushed fully into the sample. The needle contains a thin heating wire and a temperature sensor sealed in a steel tube. A constant current heats the wire, the temperature rise is logged for 180 seconds, and conductivity is calculated from the slope of temperature against the logarithm of time. The result is shown on the meter after a single button press, and saved readings can be transferred to a computer over USB. Three needles are available: the standard 100 mm probe for soils and soft materials, the 50 mm probe for hard samples such as rock, concrete and polymers, which is inserted into a 4 mm hole drilled with a supplied masonry bit and used with contact grease, and the 150 mm probe for soils under IEEE 442-2017. Meter and probes are auto-recognised and the right test parameters load automatically. The instrument is used for soil dry-out curves, backfill selection for buried power cables and pipelines, geotechnical and geothermal studies, concrete mix development and polymer research. Conductivity ranges from 0.1 to 5 W/m·K with 5 % accuracy and 2 % repeatability.

ar.description: يقيس TLS-100 الموصلية الحرارية والمقاومية الحرارية بمجس إبري يُدفع بالكامل داخل العينة. تحتوي الإبرة على سلك تسخين رفيع وحساس حرارة مغلقين بإحكام داخل أنبوب فولاذي. يسخّن تيار ثابت السلك، ويُسجَّل ارتفاع الحرارة على مدى 180 ثانية، وتُحسب الموصلية من ميل الحرارة مقابل لوغاريتم الزمن. وتظهر النتيجة على المقياس بعد ضغطة زر واحدة، ويمكن نقل القراءات المحفوظة إلى حاسوب عبر USB. تتوفر ثلاث إبر: المجس القياسي 100 mm للتربة والمواد الرخوة، والمجس 50 mm للعينات الصلبة مثل الصخور والخرسانة والبوليمرات، ويُدخَل في ثقب بقطر 4 mm يُحفر بلقمة بناء مرفقة ويُستخدم مع شحم تلامس، والمجس 150 mm للتربة وفق IEEE 442-2017. ويُعرَّف المقياس والمجسات تلقائيًا وتُحمَّل معلمات الاختبار الصحيحة تلقائيًا. ويُستخدم الجهاز في منحنيات جفاف التربة واختيار مواد الردم لكابلات الطاقة وخطوط الأنابيب المدفونة والدراسات الجيوتقنية والجيوحرارية وتطوير الخلطات الخرسانية وأبحاث البوليمرات. تتراوح الموصلية من 0.1 إلى 5 W/m·K بدقة 5 % وقابلية تكرار 2 %.

products.name: MP-1 TPS Battery Package
products.summary: The TPS Battery Package configures the MP-1 to measure the directional thermal conductivity, thermal diffusivity and specific heat of cylindrical, prismatic and pouch battery cells. It combines specific heat, one-dimensional and anisotropic testing modules with cell-specific Cp cells, TPS sensors and insulation blocks.
products.description: Battery thermal management depends on knowing how heat moves along and across a cell, and this package adapts the MP-1 method to measure it. Three testing modules are included. The Specific Heat module uses a Cp cell shaped for the cell format: a reference run with the empty cell is followed by a run with the battery inserted, and results are reported as heat capacity in J/K, specific heat in kJ/kg·K and volumetric specific heat in MJ/m³K. The one-dimensional module measures conductivity and diffusivity along the height of the cell with a single-sided sensor, using an insulation block on cylindrical cells to guard against lateral heat loss. The anisotropic module measures axial and radial conductivity. For cylindrical cells the package covers diameters of 10 to 60 mm, such as 21700 cells, and for prismatic and pouch cells it handles dimensions up to 250 × 250 mm, with sensor configurations that can be single-sided, two-sided or integrated inside a pouch. The standard temperature range is −75 to 90 °C and can be extended to 300 °C. Custom Cp cells and sensors can be built for other cell sizes.

ar.description: تعتمد الإدارة الحرارية للبطاريات على معرفة كيفية انتقال الحرارة على امتداد الخلية وعبرها، وتكيّف هذه الحزمة طريقة MP-1 لقياس ذلك. وتتضمن ثلاث وحدات اختبار. تستخدم وحدة الحرارة النوعية خلية Cp مشكَّلة بحسب شكل الخلية: يُجرى تشغيل مرجعي بالخلية الفارغة يتبعه تشغيل مع إدخال البطارية، وتُبلَّغ النتائج كسعة حرارية بوحدة J/K وحرارة نوعية بوحدة kJ/kg·K وحرارة نوعية حجمية بوحدة MJ/m³K. وتقيس الوحدة أحادية البعد الموصلية والانتشارية على ارتفاع الخلية بحساس أحادي الجانب، مستخدمةً كتلة عزل على الخلايا الأسطوانية للحماية من الفقد الحراري الجانبي. وتقيس الوحدة المتباينة الخواص الموصلية المحورية والشعاعية. وبالنسبة للخلايا الأسطوانية تغطي الحزمة أقطارًا من 10 إلى 60 mm، مثل خلايا 21700، وللخلايا المنشورية والكيسية تتعامل مع أبعاد حتى 250 × 250 mm، مع تكوينات حساسات يمكن أن تكون أحادية الجانب أو ثنائية الجانب أو مدمجة داخل الكيس. ونطاق الحرارة القياسي من −75 إلى 90 °C ويمكن تمديده إلى 300 °C. ويمكن بناء خلايا Cp وحساسات مخصصة لأحجام خلايا أخرى.
